changelog:
Initial release of Seedance 2.0 video generator.

- Generate Seedance 2.0 videos through WeryAI: supports text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-image video, and first-frame/last-frame transitions.
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY and Node.js 18+; only accepts public HTTPS media URLs (no local file uploads).
- Enforces prompt expansion and explicit confirmation before paid runs.
- Supports dry-run checks for input validation and model capability testing.
- Includes migration support for WaveSpeed Seedance flows using image + last_image.
- Built with strict secret handling, input safety, and consistent outputs (taskId, videos, status).
